description: Completely rewrite the Kalkulator Premi tab in index.html to match official MiPOS data precisely. Replace the entire tab-kalkulator section HTML and its JavaScript IIFE with a new implementation supporting IDR/USD currencies, free-text santunan input, correct rate tables, proper rounding, Top Up Berkala, Masa Pembayaran Kontribusi display, and exponential interpolation.
steps:
Replace the HTML content of
(lines 479 onwards until the closing
before tab-ilustrasi) with new calculator UI containing: (1) Mata Uang toggle IDR/USD, (2) Jenis Kelamin select, (3) Usia Masuk select 18-70, (4) Santunan Asuransi free-text input with validation (IDR min 100jt max 99.9M, USD min 40000), (5) Mode Pembayaran select, (6) Top Up Berkala optional input with per-frequency minimums (IDR: 1jt/500rb/250rb/100rb for tahunan/sem/kuar/bul; USD: 100/50/25/10), (7) Masa Pembayaran Kontribusi display (110-usia, greyed out), (8) Pilihan Masa Asuransi Tambahan select (default 'Sama seperti Kontribusi Dasar', adds 60/70/80/90 options when waiver is checked), (9) Checkbox MiSmart Critical Care Syariah with santunan input (IDR min 20jt, USD min 2000, max 3x base), (10) Checkbox MiSmart Waiver Syariah

Replace the entire IIFE JavaScript block for the calculator (starting from '// ============ KALKULATOR KONTRIBUSI MiSSION Syariah ============') with new implementation that uses EXACT verified rate data points and exponential interpolation between them

Implement exponential interpolation: rate(age) = rate(knownAge1) * (rate(knownAge2)/rate(knownAge1))^((age-knownAge1)/(knownAge2-knownAge1)). For ages outside the 2 known points, extrapolate using the same exponential growth rate.

Implement IDR rounding: annual values use Math.round(rawValue/100)*100; frequency division also rounds each component individually with Math.round(annualComponent/freq/100)*100, then sum components for total. Ujrah annual also rounds to nearest 100.

Implement USD rounding: Math.round(value) for kontribusi amounts (integers). Ujrah displayed to 2 decimal places. For frequency: Math.round(annual/freq) for each component individually, then sum for total.

Implement calculation flow: (a) compute annual rate for each component using exponential interpolation, (b) scale by santunan amount (IDR: santunan/1000000000, USD: santunan/100000), (c) round annual to nearest 100 for IDR or nearest integer for USD kontribusi, (d) compute per-frequency by dividing annual by freq and rounding per component, (e) sum all per-frequency components for Kontribusi Dasar & Rider total

Implement output display showing: Kontribusi Dasar per period, Ujrah Asuransi Dasar (annual, not divided by freq), per rider: Kontribusi + Ujrah, Total Kontribusi Dasar & Rider per period, Masa Pembayaran Kontribusi. For USD, show minimum kontribusi warning if total < USD 34.
Add input formatting: IDR inputs should auto-format with thousand separators (dots), USD inputs with commas. Validate min/max on blur. CI santunan max = 3x base santunan (not 6x).

IMPORTANT ROUNDING CORRECTION for waiver IDR: The waiver for Pria 31 base 1M shows: tahunan 1,115,900 / semesteran 558,000 / kuartalan 278,900 / bulanan 93,000. Note that 1,115,900/2=557,950 rounds to 558,000; 1,115,900/4=278,975 rounds to 278,900 (floor to 100); 1,115,900/12=92,991.67 rounds to 93,000. This confirms: semesteran uses Math.round(annual/2/100)*100, kuartalan uses Math.floor(annual/4/100)*100, bulanan uses Math.round(annual/12/100)*100. HOWEVER checking Pria 45 CI: 24,630,000/12=2,052,500 but MiPOS shows 2,052,400. And 24,630,000/4=6,157,500 matches. So there may be slight internal rate precision differences. Use Math.round(annual/freq/100)*100 as default for IDR (accepts +/- 100 IDR tolerance).
